description:
Space researcher, tech builder, and participant in the NASA International Space Apps Challenge 2026. I’m currently building an interactive web-based SPHEREx data explorer designed to turn complex astrophysical data into an intuitive "X-ray" experience for the cosmos.
My work focuses on bridging the gap between raw NASA IRSA/IPAC data—like 102 infrared wavelength bands and multi-detector array feeds—and clean, browser-native UI design. we  love buildings prototypes that make space exploration fun
